name: SK_ID_CURR
details: ID of loan in our sample - one loan in our sample can have 0,1,2 or more related previous credits in credit bureau [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: SK_ID_BUREAU
details: Recoded ID of previous Credit Bureau credit related to our loan (unique coding for each loan application) [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: CREDIT_ACTIVE
details: Status of the Credit Bureau (CB) reported credits

name: CREDIT_CURRENCY
details: Recoded currency of the Credit Bureau credit [Metadata note: recoded.]

name: DAYS_CREDIT
details: How many days before current application did client apply for Credit Bureau credit [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE
details: Number of days past due on CB credit at the time of application for related loan in our sample

name: DAYS_CREDIT_ENDDATE
details: Remaining duration of CB credit (in days) at the time of application in Home Credit [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: DAYS_ENDDATE_FACT
details: Days since CB credit ended at the time of application in Home Credit (only for closed credit) [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: AMT_CREDIT_MAX_OVERDUE
details: Maximal amount overdue on the Credit Bureau credit so far (at application date of loan in our sample)

name: CNT_CREDIT_PROLONG
details: How many times was the Credit Bureau credit prolonged

name: AMT_CREDIT_SUM
details: Current credit amount for the Credit Bureau credit

name: AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT
details: Current debt on Credit Bureau credit

name: AMT_CREDIT_SUM_LIMIT
details: Current credit limit of credit card reported in Credit Bureau

name: AMT_CREDIT_SUM_OVERDUE
details: Current amount overdue on Credit Bureau credit

name: CREDIT_TYPE
details: Type of Credit Bureau credit (Car, cash,...)

name: DAYS_CREDIT_UPDATE
details: How many days before loan application did last information about the Credit Bureau credit come [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: AMT_ANNUITY
details: Annuity of the Credit Bureau credit
